versions.changelog:
Initial release of windows-agent: A comprehensive Windows desktop automation tool.

- Enables viewing screen, taking screenshots, window control (move, resize, activate, close, open), simulated mouse/keyboard input, UI automation, and process management—all via PowerShell scripts (pwsh, PS7).
- No node or tray app required; all scripts located in the skill's scripts/ folder.
- Includes safety rules (e.g., confirm before closing windows or overwriting clipboard).
- Provides practical usage guides, common task workflows, and best practices to avoid pitfalls with Windows desktop automation.
- Supports advanced operations: visual observation, batch inputs, waiting for windows/text, UIA-based operations, smart application launching, and more.
